accountDetails.title: Ƙirƙiri asusunka
accountDetails.heading: Ƙirƙiri asusunka
accountDetails.intro: Wannan wajibi ne. Ci gaba don ƙirƙirar asusunka a kan {{ server_name }}. Ba za ka iya canza wannan daga baya ba.
accountDetails.checking: Ana duba ko sunan mai amfani yana da samuwa…
accountDetails.errorRequired: Wannan wajibi ne. Da fatan za a samar da sunan mai amfani
accountDetails.errorTooLong: Yayi tsawo, da fatan za a zaɓi wani gajere
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Sunan mai amfani mara inganci, da fatan za a yi amfani da {{ allowed_characters }} kawai
accountDetails.errorNotAvailable: {{ username }} baya samuwa, da fatan za a zaɓi wani.
redirectConfirm.title: Ci gaba zuwa asusunka
redirectConfirm.heading: Ci gaba zuwa asusunka
redirectConfirm.trust: Ci gaba zai ba {{ display_url }} damar shiga asusunka.
ssoError.title: Tabbatarwa ta gaza
ssoError.unauthorised: Ba a yarda ka shiga nan ba.
ssoError.heading: An sami kuskure
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Idan kana ganin wannan shafin bayan danna hanyar haɗi da aka aiko maka ta imel, tabbatar cewa ka danna hanyar haɗin tabbatarwa sau ɗaya kawai, kuma ka buɗe hanyar haɗin tabbatarwa a cikin abokin ciniki ɗaya da kake shiga daga ciki.
ssoError.retryHint: Gwada sake shiga Pangea Chat kuma idan matsalar ta ci gaba da fatan za a tuntuɓi mai gudanar da sabar.
authSuccess.title: Nasara!
authSuccess.mayClose: Yanzu za ka iya rufe wannan taga kuma ka koma ga aikace-aikacen
registrationSuccess.title: Tabbatarwa ta yi nasara
registrationSuccess.body: Taya murna! An tabbatar da imel ɗinka. Da fatan za a koma ga app ɗin don shiga!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Tabbatar da sake saita kalmar sirri
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Ka nemi sake saita kalmar sirri ta asusunka na Pangea Chat. Danna hanyar haɗin da ke ƙasa don tabbatar da wannan aikin.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Idan ba ka yi nufin yin wannan ba, da fatan za a rufe wannan shafin kuma ba za a canza kalmar sirrinka ba.
